name: Advancing Front Isosurface Meshing
definition: A meshing algorithm that creates a triangular mesh from fixed isosurface nodes by connecting them, adapted from the advancing front technique to avoid deleting pre-computed nodes.
summary: Advancing Front Isosurface Meshing generates watertight triangular meshes by constructing isosurface segments separately for each intersected cube, preserving pre-computed nodes and ensuring local consistency.
